archetypes.name: postplan-rc
archetypes.rationale: Step 2 postplan rc mapping is subtle and user-visible.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Python Step 2 postplan helper and drafter integration for parity with the retired Bash behavior. Focus on rc 10, 11, 12, 13, fatal rc 1 and 2 mapping, pause-save sys.exit behavior, and stdout row ordering. Check that nonfatal postplan outcomes exit zero while still surfacing POSTPLAN_RC rows. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: env-rehydrate
archetypes.rationale: Session env overlay order affects pause-save, validation, and token recording.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the shared wrapper runtime and validator-autofix rehydration. Verify allowlisted session-env parsing, shlex-quoted values with spaces, os.environ export before in-process helper calls, binary-found derivation, and plugin-root validation ordering. Pay special attention to Step 2a's no-plugin-root non-pause carve-out. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: launcher-docs
archetypes.rationale: Launcher-routed retired names must stay aligned across docs, harnesses, and generated dispatch.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the launcher mapping, Makefile/checks retargeting, and design docs for consistency. Confirm caller argv tails are forwarded, test override seams remain single-executable stubs, and compatibility references do not undermine the Python authority wording. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
